title: Dale T NDE 5198
content: It was about 55 years ago, and I was around 6 years old. I was eating dinner with my older brother (age 12) and my mother. I swallowed a piece of meat, which was unfortunately attached, by a sinew to another one still in my mouth, and swallowing the first piece caused the second one to block my windpipe. I could not breathe and, according to my brother, I turned blue. Suddenly I was observing the event from a corner of the room near the ceiling. I could 'see' ME lying on the floor, and my brother and mother watching helplessly. Beside me, in my corner near the ceiling, I sensed a being. I did not know who this being was, but it seemed to me that he was a spiritual 'big brother' that I had known since forever. Together we watched the events occurring below, as though it was all pre-planned. I knew that we would just wait a bit until things changed somehow, and then we would know when it was the right time, which would be when I would go back to my body. There was absolutely no fear, no concern at all. 'We' knew exactly how this would play out. I don't know how to say it. Something like 'It's so obvious how this will turn out' was what we were both thinking. Suddenly I was back in my body, and I found that I had brought back with me the knowledge that I needed - to swallow the second piece of meat in order to keep from suffocating.

arrival.other_being_detail: Sensed a being beside him near the ceiling; seemed like a spiritual 'big brother' he had known since forever.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Choking on meat; windpipe blocked; could not breathe and turned blue.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Sense of a benevolent 'spiritual big brother' and shared knowing that events were pre-planned and would resolve; returned with practical knowledge to swallow the second piece of meat.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE observing from near-ceiling corner with sensed being; no tunnel/light/environment; sudden return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Shared sense with the being that the situation was 'pre-planned' and would obviously resolve, and returning with specific actionable knowledge (to swallow the second piece of meat) to stop suffocating.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly I was observing the event from a corner of the room near the ceiling.” “I sensed a being… a spiritual ‘big brother’ that I had known since forever.” “There was absolutely no fear, no concern at all.” “Suddenly I was back in my body… the knowledge that I needed - to swallow the second piece of meat…”
